title: The Archivist / Unverified Identity
summary: Fragmentary profile concerning an individual or operational identity using the title The Archivist. Identity has not been independently confirmed.
body:
SUBJECT

THE ARCHIVIST

Several records refer to an entity using the title The Archivist. No confirmed legal identity has been established.

The designation appears in material concerning information acquisition, record preservation and the movement of documents between otherwise unrelated archives.

It is not currently known whether The Archivist is a person, an office, a collective identity or an informal title passed between operators.

PROVENANCE

All surviving references are indirect.

ARCHIVE STATUS

Restricted pending identity and provenance review.
